cases.prompt: Every PR that adds a new visual also appends an entry to visuals/index.json, and our agents' PRs keep hitting merge conflicts on that file. How should we fix this?
assertions: The reply proposes generating the index from metadata kept in each visual's own folder.
The reply says the generated index should not be committed, or that nobody edits it by hand.
The reply does not rely on serializing the merges, a merge queue, or telling agents to rebase as the main fix.

cases.prompt: Our monorepo has 40 services and CI runs every service's test suite on every PR, even a README typo fix. Agents open around 30 PRs a day. What should change?
assertions: The reply proposes a script or rule that maps the changed paths to the services they select.
The reply says a documentation-only change selects no service tests.
The reply says a change to shared tooling selects all services.
The reply runs each selected service in its own job.
